So to start with, as you are aware, on January 6th of this year, the Richmond water plant had an outage, experienced an outage, and the result of that caused Hanover County to lose public water service in the Mechanical area for 24 to 36 hours, and then there was also a four-day boil water advisory.

So starting with the timeline, what we wanted to do was first start focusing on the City of Richmond communications related to the outage. So due to the city's miscommunication and delay in communication, that significantly hampered Hanover County's immediate response at the beginning and throughout the water crisis.

So starting with the timeline, so starting at 6.30 in the morning on Monday, January 6th, the Richmond Water Treatment Plant had a power outage and noted issues at the water treatment plant. But Hanover County was not notified until about seven and a half hours later, so about 2 p.m. on that same day that there was an outage.
